source_text: Manhu — quid est hoc? Ignorantia nomen fecit. Etiam nunc multi panem vitae vident et interrogant.
pass_a_gloss: Manhu — what is this? Ignorance name made. Even now many bread of-life see and ask.
pass_b_english: [[Manhu — “What is this?” >> Bible:Exodus 16:15]]. Ignorance named the gift. Even now many see the bread of life and still ask.
